## Navigation Model

The hierarchy below distinguishes book order, part overviews, chapter files, and in-chapter anchors. Chapter titles link to their source files; heading anchors remain owned by those files and may change when headings change.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Book[Handbook] --> Foundations[Foundations and core disciplines]
    Book --> Platforms[Cloud, delivery, and platform practice]
    Book --> Architecture[Architecture methods and cases]
    Book --> References[Appendices and indexes]
    Foundations --> PartOverview[Part overview]
    Platforms --> PartOverview
    Architecture --> PartOverview
    References --> PartOverview
    PartOverview --> Chapter[Chapter file]
    Chapter --> Heading[Heading anchor]
```

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    OrderedParts[BOOK_PLAN reading order] --> Part[Part overview]
    Part --> Chapter[Sorted chapter files]
    Chapter --> Next[Next chapter in reading sequence]
    Next --> Next
```

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    PartLink[Part link] --> Overview[PART_OVERVIEW.md]
    Overview --> ChapterLink[Chapter file link]
    ChapterLink --> HeadingLink[Stable heading anchor]
    SourceHeading[Chapter level-one heading] --> Label[Generated chapter label]
    Label --> ChapterLink
```

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    Plan[BOOK_PLAN.md] --> Generator[Combined contents generator]
    ChapterFiles[Chapter filenames and headings] --> Generator
    Generator --> Markdown[Standalone combined contents]
    Markdown --> Reader[Markdown navigation]
    BuildScript[build-book.ps1] --> Pandoc[Pandoc heading-based TOC]
    ChapterFiles --> Pandoc
```

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Sources[Plan, overviews, and chapter files] --> Generate[Regenerate contents]
    Generate --> Links[Validate every local link]
    Links --> Counts[Compare chapter and part counts]
    Counts --> Diff[Check generated-file drift]
    Diff -->|Clean| Publish[Commit source and generated artifact together]
    Diff -->|Changed| Generate
```

The generator found 391 chapter files across 26 parts. Run it with -Check in validation to detect stale generated output.
